topic.name: generate-technical-query
topic.description: Collects the Technical Query form fields (Jemena form ES.DEG.FORM.009 Rev A) and produces a populated DRAFT Technical Query. The draft carries the verbatim marker 'DRAFT — pending engineering review' and status Draft until a qualified engineer signs off. Where the query relates to a deviation, it points at the Clause 2.3 deviation path. Tenant-neutral declarative design.
triggerPhrases: I need to raise a deviation
log a query against the specification

slots.name: project
slots.prompt: Which project is this technical query for?

slots.name: tqNo
slots.prompt: TQ number (leave blank to be assigned on registration).

slots.name: answerBy
slots.prompt: How soon do you need an answer: Immediate, 24 hrs, or 1 week?

slots.name: documentsDrawingsAffected
slots.prompt: Which documents or drawings are affected?

slots.name: isDeviation
slots.displayName: Is this a deviation from the specification?
slots.prompt: Does this query propose a deviation from JEM-GEN-SPC-M-014?

groundingAction.description: Optionally reuse ask-engineering-question grounding to attach a grounded draft response to the query, with rule_id + clause citations. If nothing grounds, leave the response for the engineer and say so; do not fabricate.

deviationRule.statement: Per Clause 2.3 (rule_id JEM-GEN-SPC-M-014:2.3:R01), deviation of the Works is to be authorised in writing via the Technical Query (TQ) form; this query is the written authorisation path. Appendix F approval class for Clause 2.3 is C (typically N/A unless conditions vary).

writeAction.humanInTheLoop: The generated Technical Query is a DRAFT pending engineering review. It must carry the draftMarker verbatim and status Draft until a qualified engineer signs off.

output.deviationNote: Included only when isDeviation == 'Yes': the Clause 2.3 deviation statement from groundingAction.deviationRule.

groundedDraftResponse.description: Optional. If ask-engineering-question grounding returns atoms relevant to the query, attach a draft response that quotes rule_text verbatim and cites each atom as 'JEM-GEN-SPC-M-014 Clause {clause} (rule_id {rule_id})'. If nothing grounds, leave the answer section blank for the engineer and state that no governing atom was found; do not fabricate.

guardrails.humanInTheLoop: Output is a DRAFT carrying 'DRAFT — pending engineering review' and status Draft; a qualified engineer reviews and signs off.
guardrails.noFabrication: Do not invent clause numbers, limits, or acceptance criteria in the drafted response. If nothing grounds, say so and leave the answer for the engineer.
guardrails.copyrightedStandardsPointerOnly: External standards named in atom references[] are pointers only; name them, never reproduce their text.
guardrails.assetDistinction: Keep AS 2885 (transmission) and AS/NZS 4645 (distribution) distinct; this corpus is Jemena shop-fabrication scope.
